contexts.text: To cleave to his wife () = that the internal may be in the external.
Cannot produce a single idea without what is profane adhering...
The love of self... which inheres and adheres...
This time will my man cleave to me (), in the supreme sense, = love and mercy; in the internal, charity; in the external, conjunction; here, spiritual love. Explained, Illustrated.
The term cleave, from which Levi was named...
In the Word, celestial love, and also marriage love, are expressed by to cleave; but this is a different word in the Original Language... This Word = a still closer conjunction. Illustrated.
His soul clave unto Dinah () = an inclination to conjunction.
Therefore it cannot but be that the filthy thing-, and also the evils and falsities, from the life in the world, should adhere...

So long as a man believes that he does all things from himself... so long evils adhere to him; but so soon as he believes that goods flow in from the Lord, and evils from Hell... evils do not adhere to him.
No religious principle whatever is to be adhered to in which there is evil. Signified.
In proportion as the affection reigns, the evil Spirits adhere and do not recede.
As man believes that whatever he does he does from himself, the evil he does adheres to him as his own.
Levi was named from cleaving, by which in the Word is signified conjunction through love.
To cleave (to his wife) = to devote himself to the love of his wife.
The Jews have firmly adhered to their religion.
To cleave is a term of the good of love, for he who loves, also cleaves.
